rounding: ceil to whole unit, then max with course reserve
customer_identity: Optional client-supplied customer_id in message/request metadata; self-reported, not authenticated. Anonymous buyers get welcome quote.
counting: Completed sales across all items for the supplied ID, unique task IDs, persisted in append-only seller memory. Canceled and open tasks do not count. Tier locked when a task is opened; concurrent tasks may receive the same tier.
memory_failure: Welcome quote if memory cannot be loaded; no claim of verified purchase history.
consent: User selected historical-base maximum 10%/5% discounts with reserves retained.
